steps.title: Observe Arcade State
steps.goal: Inspect existing Arcade runtime, schemas, templates, pages, and portfolio data before choosing work.
steps.prompt: Report what is true now, what is blocked, and the smallest next useful ArcadeBuilder improvement. Do not edit files.

steps.title: Expand Seed Flags
steps.goal: Turn one-word flags into a compact game intent.
steps.prompt: Expand the tiny Arcade flags into a concise game premise, audience feel, and runtime target. Keep output bounded.

steps.title: Select Runtime Mode
steps.goal: Choose or confirm the shared Arcade runtime mode.
steps.prompt: Pick the best existing Arcade runtime mode for the flags. Do not invent a new mode unless the current modes cannot express the idea.

steps.title: Plan Game Loop
steps.goal: Define the core action, scoring, fail state, and progression loop.
steps.prompt: Create a compact loop plan with player action, feedback, scoring, fail state, and one progression idea.

steps.title: Plan Theme Pack
steps.goal: Define palette, mood, labels, and presentation constraints.
steps.prompt: Create a compact theme pack from the flags. Keep it compatible with shared Arcade assets and greybox visuals.

steps.title: Plan Content Contract
steps.goal: Define reusable content objects and how JSON expresses them.
steps.prompt: List the content objects the JSON needs and how the runtime should use them. Stay within existing Arcade runtime patterns.

steps.title: Plan Schema Fields
steps.goal: Identify needed schema or template changes for this game type.
steps.prompt: Identify the minimum schema/template fields needed for this idea. Prefer existing fields and name any real gaps.

steps.title: Fill JSON
steps.prompt: Produce JSON-ready decisions only. Do not write JavaScript or invent external assets.

steps.title: Repair JSON
steps.goal: Fix validation errors without inventing runtime code.
steps.prompt: Given validation errors, propose the smallest JSON/schema repair. Preserve the original flags.

steps.title: Build Arcade Entry
steps.goal: Write JSON, shell page, and portfolio registration through existing builder code.
steps.prompt: Prepare build-ready instructions for the existing Arcade builder. Do not bypass validation.

steps.title: Validate Build
steps.goal: Run allowed CLI, NPX, and browser checks.
steps.prompt: Verify the ArcadeBuilder output with allowed commands. Do not add smoke or unit tests unless asked.

steps.title: Recommend Next
steps.goal: Write the next useful packet or finish.
steps.prompt: Summarize what should happen next, exact blockers, and the next safe packet if work remains.
